theorems.name: Submission.bf_coneMass_ball_le
theorems.statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ), 0 < n → ∀ (W : Submodule ℝ (Rn (n + ℓ))), finrank ℝ W = n → ∀ (s δ c : ℝ), 0 < s → s < 1 → 0 < δ → 0 ≤ c → ∀ B : Set (Rn (n + ℓ)), PurelyUnrectifiable n B → (∀ x ∈ B, ∀ r : ℝ, 0 < r → r < δ → μHE[n] (B ∩ ({y | ‖W.starProjection (y - x)‖ < s * ‖y - x‖} ∩ Metric.ball x r)) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (c * (r * s) ^ n)) → ∀ a : Rn (n + ℓ), μHE[n] (B ∩ Metric.ball a (δ / 8)) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (2 * 15 ^ n * c * δ ^ n)
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
